messages.subject: MENTORS REQUIRED FOR GSOC 2016
parts:
I have gone through the projects R has lined up for this year's GSOC and it was mentioned that I could find interested mentors in this Google Group.
I am interested in statistical computing with R and specifically the following three projects:


1. Caffe deep learning framework

2. Deep Learning with mxnet

3. Regularized interval regression


My motivation to take up these projects are based on my previous experiences with projects in Machine Learning and Data Analytics.
I have taken the hands-on course offered by NVIDIA on Deep Learning and am currently familiarizing myself with Deep Learning through the Stanford course, CS231n: Convolutional Neural Networks for Visual Recognition.

I am thus in need of mentors proficient in R and who are willing to help out with developing any of the three ideas mentioned above.


--Shreyas Ramesh
